'''''Haven''''' was a luxury [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] built by [[Garblaque]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Garblaque was terrified of being caught up in the conflict, and so decided to set out on a ten-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] pleasure cruise aboard the ''Haven''; however, he bankrupted himself in the process of building the ship, and was forced to auction off thousands of seats in order to pay for the ship. The ''Haven'' featured [[Marble/Legends|marble]] floors, fur carpets, and [[Massage droid/Legends|massage droids]] in every cabin, and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Beryl Thorne]] heard rumors of a "wine spa." Thorne and the [[Voidhound]] tried to acquire tickets to the ''Haven'', but only ended up getting tickets to deck seven, which was reserved for [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-breathers and non-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].
